about: Hand-written from the Vestas Annual Report 2025, pages 50-51 and 71-74, read against the page images. DRAFT: written by one reviewer, so labels (especially categories) reflect one person's judgement. Scope rule: risks TO the company only; impacts, opportunities and items scored immaterial are excluded.

risks.title: Geopolitics and regulatory framework
risks.mitigation_quote: We manage geopolitical risks by continuously monitoring global developments and implementing appropriate mitigations.

risks.title: Project execution
risks.mitigation_quote: We mitigate execution risks through project governance, enhanced planning functions, and continuous alignment between commercial and delivery teams.

risks.title: Cyber attacks
risks.mitigation_quote: As a global manufacturer and key contributor to critical infrastructure, Vestas is required to continuously address evolving cyber risks, both to our company and to the customers we serve.

risks.title: Cost implication of injuries in own workforce
Cost implications of injuries to contractors and sub-contractors
Fines related to forced or child labour
